description: This file defines a base class for streaming CSV export commands within the Superset project, including context management, CSV data generation, and database query execution with streaming support.

classes.name: BaseStreamingCSVExportCommand
classes.description: Abstract base class providing CSV streaming functionality, including SQL execution, row processing, and context preservation.

methods.name: preserve_g_context
methods.description: Context manager that restores flask.g attributes for request-scoped data during streaming.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the streaming command with a specified chunk size.

methods.name: _get_sql_and_database
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve SQL query and database object for execution.

methods.name: _get_row_limit
methods.description: Abstract method to specify row limit for export.

methods.name: _write_csv_header
methods.description: Writes CSV header row and returns header data and byte size.

methods.name: _process_rows
methods.description: Processes database rows, yields CSV data chunks with row and byte counts.

methods.name: _execute_query_and_stream
methods.description: Executes SQL query with streaming and yields CSV data chunks.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Returns a generator function that streams CSV data, maintaining Flask app context.
